title: Venta
description: A C2C marketplace for used PC components in the Philippines, currently in development. The REST API is built with Node.js, Express and MongoDB: JWT authentication with server-side logout revocation, listing management with an admin approval workflow, direct-to-S3 photo uploads via pre-signed URLs, and buyer-seller messaging (in progress). The React frontend and AWS Lambda deployment are next.

title: Allure
description: A companion services marketplace built with Vue 3 and Node.js, featuring role-based access, JWT authentication, service browsing, cart management, and appointment booking, with dedicated interfaces for customers and administrators.

title: Daily Coding Challenges
description: A daily coding practice repository focused on strengthening problem-solving skills and programming fundamentals through Codewars challenges. Each challenge is solved first in JavaScript and then independently in Python, reinforcing logical thinking and familiarity with different approaches to solving problems.

title: Compliance Portfolio
description: A responsive professional portfolio built with Vue 3 to showcase compliance experience, professional projects, certifications, and technical skills. Features a modular component-based architecture, JSON-driven content management, and a serverless contact form.
